deepDives.title: Critical Linux MPTCP Remote Root Vulnerability
deepDives.whatHappened: Anthropic security researchers developed a working exploit for an unauthenticated remote root vulnerability affecting Linux servers running Multipath TCP (MPTCP) listeners.
deepDives.technicalMechanism: Flaws in the MPTCP subsystem implementation within the Linux network stack permit malicious packet sequences to corrupt kernel memory and achieve arbitrary remote code execution under the root security context.
deepDives.asciiFlow: [External Attacker] ──► [Malformed MPTCP Packets] ──► [Linux Kernel MPTCP Listener] ──► [Remote Root Access]
remediation: Update the Linux kernel to the latest stable release containing the MPTCP patch.
Disable MPTCP via sysctl parameters (`net.mptcp.mptcp_enabled=0`) if multiplexing is unnecessary.
Implement network segmentation and eBPF monitoring to detect abnormal kernel-level connection states.
deepDives.lessonsLearned: Advanced transport-layer protocol extensions introduce high-risk attack surfaces that bypass traditional user-space boundaries; kernel hardening and protocol minimization remain essential.

deepDives.title: Trojanized Claude Code Extension on Cursor Marketplace
deepDives.whatHappened: A malicious variant of Anthropic's Claude Code VS Code extension was hosted on Cursor's extension marketplace for approximately 11 hours, exposing up to 5,000 developers to persistent SSH backdoors.
deepDives.technicalMechanism: The malicious extension abused integrated development environment permissions during installation to modify user shell configurations, drop unauthorized SSH public keys into `authorized_keys`, and exfiltrate local repository credentials.
deepDives.asciiFlow: [Developer Workstation] ──► [Cursor Marketplace Extension] ──► [Dropper Script] ──► [Persistent SSH Backdoor]
remediation: Immediately remove unauthorized or unverified IDE extensions and inspect system `~/.ssh/authorized_keys` files.
Enforce strict cryptographic signing and publisher verification for all internal and external developer tooling.
Rotate all credentials, SSH keys, and cloud API tokens stored on affected developer workstations.
deepDives.lessonsLearned: AI-assisted coding environments and their marketplaces represent prime targets for supply chain attackers seeking immediate lateral movement into enterprise source code repositories.

deepDives.title: Vapor Panda Deploys AI-Powered ARTEX Framework
deepDives.whatHappened: CrowdStrike attributed a broad global campaign targeting over 200 organizations to Chinese state-sponsored adversary Vapor Panda, utilizing an AI-driven Go penetration testing framework named ARTEX.
deepDives.technicalMechanism: ARTEX automates reconnaissance, vulnerability enumeration, and exploit chaining using embedded artificial intelligence heuristics written in Go, allowing simultaneous high-speed intrusion operations across multiple enterprise targets.
deepDives.asciiFlow: [Vapor Panda Operators] ──► [ARTEX AI Framework (Go)] ──► [Automated Recon & Exploit] ──► [Compromised Enterprise Networks]
remediation: Deploy EDR behavioral rules to detect anomalous compilation artifacts and execution patterns of Go-based binaries.
Monitor for unauthorized automated scanning tools and sudden bursts of outbound enumeration traffic.
Enhance threat intelligence sharing regarding Vapor Panda indicators of compromise (IoCs).
deepDives.lessonsLearned: Adversaries are actively operationalizing generative and autonomous AI frameworks to scale targeted intrusion operations, reducing reliance on manual operator interaction.

detectionRules.title: Suspicious SSH Authorized Keys Modification by IDE Extension
detectionRules.mitreTechnique: T1098.004 - Account Manipulation: SSH Authorized Keys
detectionRules.code:
title: Unauthorized SSH Authorized Keys Modification
status: production
description: Detects modifications to SSH authorized_keys files originating from developer IDE or extension execution paths.
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: linux
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|contains: '/.ssh/authorized_keys'
    Image|contains:
      - '/cursor/'
      - '/vscode/'
      - '/node_modules/'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate administrative key deployments through configuration management.
level: high
